purpose: Route a supported base-question defect through the existing one quality repair even when numerical controls pass.
change: New inspection-enabled reviews explicitly assess exact-quoted base-question issues. Acceptance cannot ignore them. Source-approved question-only defects with passing recorded basic controls may use the existing correction route before the grader repair allowance is spent.
integrity: Bind original grader, review and control receipt hashes; require a unique original candidate and unchanged source-approved endpoint scope. Repair targets are restricted to the public question for semantic-only evidence. Fresh isolated validation uses the frozen scientific assets/grader with no additional quality repair.
historical_compatibility: Old reviews without question_issues remain readable. Current frozen runs and their accepted:true records are unchanged; successful original gates do not override later recorded public-contract concerns.
prompt_changes: Avoid unsupported textbook explanations; verify logical conditions and quantifiers against encoded inputs/source. Do not infer redundancy merely from subset size, unnamed/discarded status, or a different larger operation.

checks.quality: Root/explicit experimental Ruff lint/format,ty and required hooks passed.

development_failures: Ruff found an imported pytest fixture shadowed by a parameter; reused it through an explicit wrapper. No scientific fixture or generated task was changed.
